name: Simple Contact Form
author: Test Author
description: A lightweight contact form module for CMS pages. Integrates with the page builder as a drag-and-drop block.

settings_fields.label: Recipient Email
settings_fields.help: Where submission notifications are sent. Leave blank to disable email.

settings_fields.label: Email Subject Prefix
settings_fields.help: The sender’s name is appended automatically.

settings_fields.default: Thank you for your message. We will get back to you soon.
settings_fields.label: Success Message
settings_fields.help: Shown after a successful submission. Overridable per block in the builder.

settings_fields.label: Spam Protection
settings_fields.help: Honeypot adds a hidden field that bots fill in, triggering silent rejection.

settings_fields.label: Store Submissions
settings_fields.help: Saves every submission to the contact_form_submissions table.
